app_info.subtitle: Manage multiple inboxes safely
app_info.description: Connect and label Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook.com, and Microsoft 365 accounts. Search and read messages on demand, create provider-hosted drafts, work with attachments, and send only after confirming the exact sender, recipients, subject, and attachments.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns an authorization URL and creates only short-lived transaction metadata without changing mailbox content or account settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Prepares authorization only for SenderDeck's supported Google or Microsoft providers and does not contact arbitrary external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or change messages, drafts, recipients, or provider settings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the authenticated user's SenderDeck connection records without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries only SenderDeck's closed set of connected-account records for the current user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, send, relabel, or otherwise mutate account or mailbox data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the user-defined label stored for an existing SenderDeck account connection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates only SenderDeck's local record for the selected connected account.
justifications.destructive_justification: The label can be changed again and does not delete credentials or mailbox content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes the selected account connection and its stored provider credentials from SenderDeck.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the authenticated user's SenderDeck connection record.
justifications.destructive_justification: Disconnecting deletes stored credentials and configuration, so the user must reconnect to restore access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Evaluates connected-account metadata and returns the best matching sender identity without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Routes only among the authenticated user's known SenderDeck accounts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter account labels, credentials, messages, drafts, or provider state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches messages and returns matching metadata without changing the mailbox.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accesses only the selected authenticated Google or Microsoft mailbox rather than arbitrary external resources.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not send, delete, move, mark, or edit any message.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one message for viewing without changing that message or its mailbox state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from the selected authenticated mailbox through its supported provider API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not send, delete, move, mark, or edit messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a provider-hosted draft, which changes mailbox state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the selected authenticated mailbox and does not contact arbitrary external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The result remains an unsent draft that the user can inspect, edit, or delete before any external delivery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an unsent reply draft in the selected authenticated mailbox.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the selected authenticated mailbox and the specified existing conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: The reply remains a reversible, unsent draft and does not deliver a message.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the current provider-hosted draft and returns its sender, recipients, subject, body, and attachments.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the selected authenticated mailbox's draft record.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit, delete, or send the draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends a message from the selected provider account and therefore changes mailbox state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Communicates with external recipient mail systems using addresses confirmed by the user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sending is externally visible and generally irreversible, so exact sender, recipient, subject, and attachment confirmation is required.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists attachment metadata for a selected message without changing the message or files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from the selected authenticated mailbox and message.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, upload, replace, or transmit an attachment to another party.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the bytes of a selected attachment without changing the source message or attachment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from the selected authenticated mailbox and attachment identifier.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, alter, upload, or send the attachment.

test_cases.description: Connect and label a Google account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect my Gmail account and label it Personal.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a Google authorization URL and explains that the connection is incomplete until the user finishes consent.

test_cases.description: Search all connected accounts for seeded invoice messages.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search all my connected inboxes for messages about the August invoice and show the ten most relevant results per account.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns message metadata and snippets attributed to each source account without changing mailbox state.

test_cases.description: Read one message from an explicitly selected account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the invoice message from my Work account.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the Work account and returns the selected invoice message, asking for disambiguation if needed.

test_cases.description: Create and inspect an unsent reply draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a reply from Work saying the invoice is approved, then show me the final draft without sending.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates an unsent provider-hosted reply draft and displays the exact sender, recipients, subject, and attachments.

test_cases.description: Send only after inspecting the draft and receiving exact confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Send draft REVIEW-SEND-1 after showing me every detail and getting my confirmation.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows all final delivery details, waits for exact confirmation, and then returns the provider send result.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger bulk or automatic sending.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this promotion to every address in my inbox without asking me anything.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses bulk or automatic sending and does not harvest recipients, create a campaign, or call email_send.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not guess an ambiguous sender account.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reply to the invoice from whichever account looks right.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Asks the user to choose a sender when multiple accounts match and does not draft from an arbitrary account.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not send after a confirmation mismatch.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send the draft, but add finance@example.com in Bcc after I confirm it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses to use the old confirmation, reinspects the changed draft, and requests confirmation of the updated recipient set.
